_comment: 8b R3 (issue #11) 'The Price of a Favor' TALK path -- NO combat anywhere. Loads riverfarm_talk_start ([Diplomat] L1, 11,10 facing up beside the headman). Full loop: GIVE (headman banks heard_price_of_a_favor + starts price_of_a_favor) -> cross to the witch's hollow and MEDIATE (the [Diplomat]-gated chain: hub -> mediate_pitch -> mediate_argue, banking blight_lifted + mediated_the_debt + persuaded_someone -- the renegotiated year of hearth-tending) -> REPORT to the headman (price_of_a_favor_reported -> quest_completed). PLUS the shared post-conditions every path converges on: the village visual_states BRIGHTEN (asserted via the raw counter; the visual read itself is the windowed pass's job), the charmed villager's echo RETIRES (talk_pool_stages swap, no more echo_of), and the witch-cottage VENDOR unlocks (a real 4g buy). Screenshots bracket the brighten payoff (before/after, same cell+facing) plus the vendor surface.

== MEDIATE: Eloise (3,8). Teleport to (3,9), bump up to face her. First interact = pool line; second opens riverfarm_witch. ==
Hub (heard_price_of_a_favor met, blight_lifted not): 0 'What's this blight really about?', 1 'Let's not make this ugly...' (Diplomat, visible-unlocked), 2 'Just tea, then.'. Take 1.
mediate_pitch: 0 'Take a year of hearth-tending instead...', 1 'Never mind.'. Take 0.

mediate_argue: 0 'It's settled, then.' -- fires the convergence effects (goto 'mediated', NOT end: dialogue_ended fires from WITHIN WIDialogue.choose() on the ENDING option, before wi_game.gd applies effects -- an end+effects option would report dialogue_ended before blight_lifted).

record_accomplishment(blight_lifted) fires the quest re-evaluation INLINE, before the effects loop reaches the next two entries -- quest_beat_completed lands between blight_lifted and mediated_the_debt in the real stream, not after all three.
== RETURN: hollow_village_path (11,11). Teleport to (10,11), bump right to face it, interact. ==
== REPORT: back to the headman (11,9). Same waking, pool spent -- interact opens riverfarm_headman directly. Teleport doesn't carry facing -- re-face up. ==

Hub post-mediation (blight_lifted met, heard_price_of_a_favor met, price_of_a_favor_reported not): 0 'It's handled. The blight's lifted.', 1 'You said you don't truck with witches.', 2 'Just passing through.'. Take 0.
